items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: Ross did book us back to work.

ctx.x: And, uh, so when we got that bus back to Huntington, we stayed there about two months without any work at all. And when we got ready to, he did book us back, uh, to work. Ross did book us back to work. And then the people, uh, King Oliver was ready from, was my lady's name was Mrs. Wisnet. W-I-Z-E-N-T. Mm-hmm. And she had a call that was just about a year or two old. And her husband let Mrs. Wisnet go with us to collect so much money per day. And she would work the doors for King because they both were crazy…
